objective: Render genuine redeemed Character collectibles consistently in Customize, Profile, Points and Economy; keep thumbnails within character cards.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub protected main 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61 inspected before change. Existing Android production proof was independent, and no OTA/production deploy is claimed. Live Supabase BUKLOD Connect public asset bucket buklod-character-art-v1 verified with 1300 exact WebP collectible paths plus 2 manifest objects.
chosenApproach: Build one small reusable Supabase public artwork renderer; resolve equipped pins by authenticated redeemed level/item, notify mounted UI without dashboard reload; align existing Character/Points/Economy card widths. Preserve R31 source presentation contract with an exact updated git blob lock.
selectionRationale: Source inspection found Customize and shared Character cards still drawing generic icon rails; Profile, Points and Economy use the same BuklodActiveCharacterArt. One contained renderer avoids copy-pasted art and inconsistent positions while server ownership remains unchanged.
alternativeApproaches: Create separate art mapping per screen (rejected due drift).
Replace character progression backend or bulk reload dashboards (rejected regression risk).
Change payout, Circle Rank or ad logic (not in scope).
preserveBehaviors: Per-character 20-level server progression, authenticated ownership, Circle Rank and existing task rewards remain server-authoritative.
No backend mutation or change to 1300 Supabase public storage objects; no account-spanning collectible award or unverified new ownership.
No AdMob, monetization, QMP/ledger, financial calculations, notifications, audio, PTT, Wall, navigation or sign-in changes.
Approved R31/R40 source identity and Special Character access locks remain intact.
Fallback generic glyph only for invalid/failed artwork requests; image errors must not crash the screen.
No production, staging OTA, native build or web release in this PR. Publication requires independent release gates and source/runtime match.
acceptanceChecks: Supabase bucket remains publicly readable with exactly 1300 expected collectible art paths and correct Christian Level 3 path.
Focused character UI parity tests pass; unrelated navigation and Ads/Points behavior stays unchanged.
Protected-character source exact Git blob release contract validates and 20-level controls preserved.
npm TypeScript, Character source contract, base release gate and compiled web contract pass in PR CI.
Engineering Accountability V2 scope governance validates exact workstream paths, protected behaviors and regression proofs.
No deployed OTA asserted without exact EAS update ID, runtime and production readback.
